name: trees
title: Trees: every tree in the lidar, catalogued trees first

sources.name: sentinel2
sources.license: Copernicus Sentinel data (free, full and open use)

commands.name: trees-load
commands.help: load a trees build made in the worker image into the database (--build DIR)

storage: Small: about 60 trees per hectare where there is canopy (the North End box: about 15,000 rows); each build's files (GeoJSON and a log) stay in $TVT_ARCHIVE/trees/<build>/.
ethics: Our own data, derived from public USGS 3DEP lidar, two Sentinel-2 NDVI images (early April and July 2025, for the conifer cue; credit "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025") and the crown model fitted on the owner's picks (and the US Forest Service's Urban Tree Database, cited). OpenStreetMap's hedges (ODbL) are a check on the shrubs, never drawn or stored. No catalogue's attributes are stored here: a catalogue (like the City of Boise's inventory, private) contributes trunk points to the build and is joined by id only on the owner's own site.
